brand.name: Velara
brand.one_line_description: Premium wireless headphones built to disappear into sound, with automatic noise cancelling and all-day battery life.
brand.mission: To help people hear the parts of their day worth hearing, and cancel out the parts that aren't.
brand.vision: In five years, Velara is the headphone people put on the moment they need to think clearly, not just listen to music.
core_values: Comfort for the whole day, not just the demo
Design that ages well, not a seasonal drop
brand.positioning_statement: For people who move all day between calls, commutes, and focus blocks, Velara is the headphone that automatically cancels the noise around you and wraps you in spatial sound, because switching modes shouldn't take a tap.
brand.differentiation: Automatic noise cancelling that reads your environment in real time without opening an app, paired with spatial sound and a 40-hour battery that outlasts a full week of commutes on a single charge.

product.name: Velara Headphones
product.description: Over-ear wireless headphones in a soft stone-grey finish, with automatic noise cancelling, spatial sound, up to 40 hours of battery life, and Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity.
key_features: Automatic noise cancelling that senses your environment and adjusts without manual switching
Spatial sound that repositions audio as you move your head
Up to 40 hours of battery life on a single charge
Bluetooth 5.3 for a stable, low-latency connection across devices
top_benefits: Walk into a loud office or train car and the noise drops out before you notice it's gone
Music, calls, and video feel like they're coming from around you, not just your ears
Charge once at the start of the week and forget about it until the weekend
product.proof_points: Rated for 40 hours of continuous playback with ANC and Bluetooth active; adaptive noise cancelling recalibrates to ambient sound every 400 milliseconds; comfort-tested across a full range of head shapes and sizes for sessions over 8 hours.
product.category: Most people currently choose between noise-cancelling headphones that need manual mode switching and truly wireless earbuds that trade battery life and bass response for portability.

audience.primary_audience: Working professionals, 26-45, who spend two or more hours a day in headphones between commuting, calls, and focus work.
audience.demographics: Urban professionals and hybrid or remote workers, mid-to-high household income, replace headphones every 2-3 years and buy premium electronics.
audience.psychographics: Values quality and design longevity over the newest feature list; frustrated by settings and apps that get in the way of just putting headphones on; treats headphones as a tool for controlling their environment, not just a music accessory.
pain_points: Constantly switching ANC and transparency modes by hand throughout the day
Headphones dying mid-afternoon on longer days
Ear fatigue and discomfort after a few hours of continuous wear
audience.desired_outcome: Putting the headphones on once in the morning and not thinking about battery, mode, or comfort again until they take them off at night.
audience.objections: Price is higher than mainstream noise-cancelling headphones; skepticism that 'automatic' ANC actually beats manual mode switching; uncertainty about how spatial sound performs outside dedicated content.
audience.secondary_audience: Frequent flyers and business travelers who want one pair of headphones that handles flights, offices, and everyday commuting equally well.

we_are: Specific about what the technology does, not just what it's called
Focused on everyday use cases: commutes, calls, open offices
Written the way a well-made product explains itself: briefly
we_are_not: Full of jargon about drivers, codecs, or chip names without explaining the benefit
Chasing every trend in 'immersive audio' marketing
Loud or hyperbolic about sound quality
tone.example_line: Noise drops away automatically. You don't have to ask it to.

offer.core_offer: 10% off your first pair, plus a complimentary travel case.
offer.pricing_packaging: $349 per pair in Stone Grey and Graphite Black, with an optional two-year extended warranty at checkout.
offer.urgency_reason: Launch pricing ends when the current production run sells out.
offer.guarantee: 30-day home trial with free returns if they're not the most comfortable headphones you've owned.
offer.post_conversion: Welcome email walks through pairing, where to find the noise-cancelling controls, and how to check battery level from the case.
